The '''Gordian Reach''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], stretching from [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] to [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was named after the route, which was erased by shifting stars long before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], though spacers still referred to the swath of space between Feriae and Belderone as the Gordian Reach on occasion. During the [[Stenax Massacres]], the [[Stenax]]es seized deadly technology that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had brought to [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]] and launched invasions of [[Kadril]], [[Arda II]], [[Sooma]], [[Alzar]], [[Tandankin]], and other worlds along the Gordian Reach.<ref name="TMS">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
